emailPreferences.title: Receive only the updates you choose
emailPreferences.description: Verified changes from your watchlist can be grouped into a digest. The notification centre remains available without email.
emailPreferences.consentTitle: Your consent stays under your control
emailPreferences.consentText: By enabling digests, you agree to receive the frequencies selected in your watches. You can withdraw this consent immediately here or from any email.
emailPreferences.frequency: Each watch keeps its daily or weekly frequency.
emailPreferences.unavailable: Confirm your email address before enabling digests.
emailPreferences.error: Your choice cannot be saved right now.
